items.title: What to watch: Broadcom, Snowflake earnings and ADP jobs data
items.summary: Asking for a Trend Host Josh Lipton previews the stories that will be making headlines tomorrow, including earnings from Broadcom (AVGO) and Snowflake (SNOW), plus a fresh look at the labor market with ADP's private payrolls report ahead of Friday's highly anticipated jobs report.

items.title: This Payroll Software Company Bought Back 20% of Its Shares and the Stock Has Nearly Doubled Since April
items.summary: While most software companies were retreating, Paycom made an aggressive and unconventional bet on itself, and the market delivered a verdict that caught even seasoned analysts off guard.

items.title: Stock Market Today: Dow, Small Caps Lead Rise; Palo Alto Networks Triggers Sell Rule (Live Coverage)
items.summary: Stock Market Today: The Dow Jones index rises Tuesday after surprise jobs data. AI stock Credo plunges on earnings.

items.title: Cramer Says This Software Giant Is Fighting a Takeover With a $4 Billion Buyback
items.summary: Silver Lake wants Workday, but Workday just fired back with $4 billion and a packed calendar of public commitments. Jim Cramer says the company is fighting its own takeover, and the five-year chart reveals what investors are actually betting on.

items.title: Is Oracle Stock A Hedge Or A Downside Trap?
items.summary: The tech giant's sudden swings can be disorienting, but its true significance for your portfolio lies in its distinct, high-octane behavior.

items.title: How Wide Is the Range of Possibilities for Adobe Stock?
items.summary: The options market is pricing a sizable year-long swing for the software giant, and if you hold the shares, you are already exposed to the full ride.

items.title: Why Is Nvidia Willing to Pay $14 Billion for Hugging Face?
items.summary: Nvidia is reportedly nearing a deal to buy AI platform Hugging Face for about $14 billion. It could be a long-term boost for the stock.
